sources.title: MotheRetreat — Birth Doula Fort Lauderdale
sources.quote: MotheRetreat provides birth doula support to families across Fort Lauderdale and the Broward coast. Whether you plan to deliver at Broward Health Medical Center, Holy Cross Health, or Broward Health Imperial Point, your birth doula gives you continuous one-on-one support through labor and coordinates closely with your medical team.

sources.title: Hummingbird Birth (Amber Marie)
sources.quote: Certified Birth & Postpartum Doula in South Florida. Serving Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton & surrounding areas — with you every step of the way. Amber has spent more than 20 years walking alongside families through birth, postpartum, and the full arc of early parenthood. Certified by ProDoula.

sources.title: zenmamalove (Martha)
sources.quote: I AM A BIRTH WORKER, not simply a photographer. I am a certified Doula and Birth Assistant. ... Birth Photographer & Doula serving Ft. Lauderdale, Boca Raton, Broward County, Delray Beach & Parkland, FL

sources.title: Serene Gato — A Serene Birth
sources.quote: Experienced birth doula serving all of Broward County and beyond. As a South Florida birth doula, I help expectant parents before, during, and immediately following birth by providing: Physical Support, Emotional Support, Resources & Information, Advocacy.
